scope: Limited RAID pilot; development/validation plumbing and methodology only.
independent_test: frozen-unopened until supervisor review; no access record claimed by preflight.
required_reports: per-split sample, label, component, and dimension counts
development and validation metrics with abstentions and operational failures separated
explicit partial-view, missing-domain, missing-generator, attack, language-hint, and native-attribution gaps
source snapshot, manifest, content, config, criteria, and binary hashes
prohibited_claims: held-out performance from development or validation results
notes: No threshold or default change was made. The pilot has no numeric release pass/fail threshold; the supervisor decides whether a frozen independent assessment is warranted.
